description: A shipped Praxis `.app` is the shell only: `src-tauri/src/library.rs` discovers the Python construction core (`curriculum.py` + `launcher/`) by walking up from the binary and the cwd, and finds an interpreter via `PRAXIS_PYTHON` / `.venv` / `python3` — nothing is embedded, so a `.app` moved away from a checkout-with-the-launch-extra reports `LauncherStatus::failed` (CLAUDE.md "Bundling"). This tasklist makes a truly standalone bundle: embed a Python interpreter plus the launch extra into the bundle so `library.rs` can start the launcher without a checkout or venv beside it, preferring the embedded runtime while keeping the existing discovery fallbacks. It is a change to the discovery ORDER and the bundle contents, not a rewrite of how the core is started. Scope: `src-tauri/src/library.rs` (interpreter discovery), the bundle config + `docs/reference/packaging.md`, and `tests/` where discovery order can be exercised. The dev flow (`.venv` + `npm run dev`) stays unchanged.
warmup: echo 'library.rs discovers curriculum.py + launcher/ by walking up, and the interpreter via PRAXIS_PYTHON / .venv / python3; embedding must be an added, preferred discovery step, not a rewrite — see CLAUDE.md "Bundling".'

userStories.title: Embed an interpreter + the launch extra, preferred by discovery
acceptanceCriteria: The bundle embeds a Python interpreter and the launch extra, and `src-tauri/src/library.rs` prefers the embedded interpreter while keeping the existing `PRAXIS_PYTHON` / `.venv` / `python3` fallbacks — the discovery ORDER gains a step, it is not replaced, and the core (`curriculum.py` + `launcher/`) is still found by the same walk-up.

Embedding is optional at build time: the dev flow (`.venv` + `npm run dev` / `cargo run --no-default-features`) is unchanged, and a build without the embed still walks up to a checkout's venv exactly as today.
Gate green: `cargo build` in src-tauri/ passes, `python3 -m pytest -q tests/` passes (including any test that exercises the discovery order), and `npm run build` in ui/ passes.
userStories.notes: cargo build green; cargo test 4 passed (discovery order); npm run build green; pytest 794 passed, 0 failed. Embed run for real: 295M staged, CPython 3.12.13 + the launch extra + 6 core entries, and the launcher served GET /healthz 200 and GET /api/library 200 (real seed domains) from that payload with cwd=/tmp.

userStories.title: A moved-away .app runs the whole loop from the embedded runtime
acceptanceCriteria: A bundle relocated away from any checkout starts the launcher from the embedded interpreter and reaches `LauncherStatus` ready (not `failed`), and the full define -> scaffold -> construct -> gate loop runs against it — demonstrated and recorded in the progress log the way CLAUDE.md "Build order" checks a real page reached the backend (a launcher access-log request, not just a titled window).

docs/reference/packaging.md is updated: what the embedded bundle contains, the discovery order (embedded first, then `PRAXIS_PYTHON` / `.venv` / `python3`), and how to build with and without the embed.
Gate green: `cargo build` in src-tauri/, `npm run build` in ui/, and `python3 -m pytest -q tests/` all pass.
userStories.notes: Built the embedded bundle (296M staged, CPython 3.12.13; Praxis.app 304M with 295M praxis-runtime), copied it to /private/tmp with no checkout above it and PRAXIS_ROOT/PRAXIS_PYTHON unset: the launcher child is the bundle's own Contents/Resources/praxis-runtime/python/bin/python3, LauncherStatus reached ready (com.apple.WebKit.Networking opened 3 connections to the launcher port, and App.tsx only fetches the library when state === 'ready'), and the whole loop ran against it — GET /api/library 200 (14 domains/245 topics), POST /api/subjects 201, scaffold 200 created=1, POST /api/construct 202 -> constructed, badge complete, 15941 chars, 6 checks, GET /api/study 200 (1 open / 5 locked serving 0 checks), POST /api/study 200 passed=True unlocking the next section, and 423 for a locked check. Found and fixed a real defect: through a symlinked path (/tmp) Tauri's resource_dir() errors and the bundle silently lost its runtime — library::bundle_resources() is the fallback, re-verified from /tmp. Gate: cargo build green, cargo test 5 passed, npm run build green, pytest 794 passed, 0 failed. docs/reference/packaging.md rewritten (contents, discovery order, building with and without the embed).
